text:
Maya: Heads-up: sharp spike in 4xx/5xx from the toolhook parser on /api/v1/call-tool since ~10:02 UTC. Customers reporting failed function calls. Starting triage thread. cc @Sam @Eli

OpsBot: ALERT: service=toolhook-parser env=prod host=tr-3 metric=4xx_rate value=18% baseline=0.6% 5xx_rate=1.2%

Sam: On it. Any customer examples? ACME showed ~200 failed requests between 10:05-10:12 with `400 schema_invalid_tool_args`.

Maya: Confirmed. Example error from ACME trace: `Invalid arg type for param \"config\": expected object, got string` (stack snippet attached in logs).

Eli: I see a deploy at 09:58 UTC for `toolhook-schema-check v2.1.4`. Correlating. Pulling full logs for tr-3 now.

Nina: Quick repro (local):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/call-tool \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"tool_id":"pdf-summary","input":"...","config":"compact"}'
```
Response: `400 {\"error\":\"schema_validation_failed\",\"message\":\"param 'config' expected object\"}`

Sam: Ok that matches. Previously the runtime accepted string `config` and coerced it; PR #4828 tightened validation to require object. That change likely rolled in 09:58.

Jenna: Customer ACME is blocked and has escalated to CSM. They need an ETA. Can we provide a short-term workaround?

Eli: Short-term fix: relax validator to coerce string->object (e.g., `{\"value\": <string>}`) for the `config` param. I can push a hotfix to canary in ~15m. Longer term: update SDK docs and add strict schema migration note.

Maya: @Eli please add unit tests, include the coercion as a feature-flagged fallback, and do a canary -> prod rollout if green. Also create an incident ticket for postmortem.

OpsBot: Deploy started: canary `toolhook-validator 2.1.5` by Eli at 10:34 UTC (canary hosts: tr-3, tr-4).

Sam: Canary looks good so far. Error rate on tr-3 dropped from 18% -> 0.9% 4xx within 8 minutes (10:42). Keeping under observation for 30m.

Jenna: I told ACME the workaround (wrap `config` as an object or wait for 45m for full fix). They acknowledged :thumbsup:.

Eli: Patch merged, prod roll started and completed 10:52 UTC. Final metrics: 4xx back to baseline across regions. Added logging to capture failed payloads with `incident:1789004321` tag for 24h.

Maya: Closing loop: filing incident CH-1234, severity Sev-2 -> resolved. Postmortem owners: Eli (lead) + Sam (metrics/release). Notes: add migration guide for schema tightening; announce in #devex before future validator bumps. Great job triaging.
